production_path_preflight.analytic_fwer_argument: under any true path null at least one positive-boundary or TOST-union-null constituent is valid and super-uniform; the path IUT maximum is therefore valid, Holm strongly controls the seven-path FWER under arbitrary dependence, and strict-CI concordance plus health gates can only remove declarations
production_path_preflight.boundary_face_role: prespecified end-to-end implementation diagnostics, not an assertion that one nuisance midpoint globally maximizes declaration probability
production_path_preflight.surface_fpr_gate: every surface independently requires the one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper bound for any assigned null path declared SUPPORTED to be <= alpha
production_path_preflight.plant_semantics: partner-only primitive plants; pseudo=0; specifics/gaps derived
